source.name: Activating a form control inside a modal must not close the modal
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/ghosh/micromodal/issues/487) at 98e003a01a6821a309f6feebc3a298e1cf472baa. Blind to the maintainers' fix c2c7d1563fc24775abd8b3fd8ba79ae85ccafe47; routing auto.

journey.title: Ticking a checkbox inside the preferences dialog keeps it open
journey.goal: Space ticks the checkbox and the dialog stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close preferences with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens and the close button dismisses it

guards.title: Done closes the preferences dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Activating Done dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: The modal's click listener uses event.target.closest('[data-micromodal-close]'), which matches any ancestor with the close trigger attribute. When the Space key triggers a click on a checkbox inside the modal, the click bubbles up to the overlay (which has data-micromodal-close), causing the modal to close unintentionally.
plan.repair_strategy: Change the click handler to only close the modal when the click target itself has the close trigger attribute, ensuring that interactions with internal controls (like checkboxes) do not propagate a close action.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on a checkbox inside the preferences dialog will toggle the checkbox and keep the dialog open, allowing users to adjust settings without inadvertently closing the modal.
functional_risks: If an element other than the overlay or close button is given the data-micromodal-close attribute, it will no longer trigger a close (though this is unlikely).
Custom implementations that rely on the previous bubbling behavior may need adjustment.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Space on the #weekly checkbox toggles its checked state and the modal remains open (aria-hidden stays false).
Verify that clicking the modal overlay or the close button still closes the modal and returns focus to the trigger.
Verify that other keyboard interactions (Tab, Escape) continue to work as expected.
